title: JPA 脏检查 vs MyBatis 显式 SQL：一次改名场景下的 SQL 条数与漏写风险
expected_output:
dirty fields(none)     : []
jpa flush no change    : None
dirty fields(name)     : ['name']
jpa flush dirty only   : UPDATE t_user SET name = ? WHERE id = ?
jpa full update        : UPDATE t_user SET name = ?, age = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?
mybatis explicit       : UPDATE t_user SET name = ? WHERE id = ?
mybatis forgotten      : None
jpa sql count(1 change): 1
mybatis sql count(miss): 0
dirty check saves full : True
forgotten loses write  : True
code:
class Entity:
    FIELDS = ("name", "age", "email")

    def __init__(self, id_, name, age, email):
        self.id = id_
        self.name = name
        self.age = age
        self.email = email
        self._snapshot = (name, age, email)

    def dirty_fields(self):
        now = (self.name, self.age, self.email)
        return [k for k, v, old in zip(Entity.FIELDS, now, self._snapshot) if v != old]


def jpa_flush(entity, dynamic_update=True):
    """JPA 脏检查：flush 时自动对比快照，只 UPDATE 变化的列。"""
    changed = entity.dirty_fields()
    if not changed:
        return None
    cols = changed if dynamic_update else list(Entity.FIELDS)
    return "UPDATE t_user SET " + ", ".join(c + " = ?" for c in cols) + " WHERE id = ?"


def mybatis_update(entity):
    """MyBatis 没有脏检查：必须在 Mapper 里显式声明 SQL 并调用。"""
    return "UPDATE t_user SET name = ? WHERE id = ?"


def report(entity):
    return entity.dirty_fields()


e1 = Entity(1, "tom", 20, "t@x.com")
print("dirty fields(none)     :", report(e1))
stmt0 = jpa_flush(e1)
print("jpa flush no change    :", stmt0)

e1.name = "tom2"
stmt1 = jpa_flush(e1)
print("dirty fields(name)     :", report(e1))
print("jpa flush dirty only   :", stmt1)
print("jpa full update        :", jpa_flush(e1, dynamic_update=False))
print("mybatis explicit       :", mybatis_update(e1))
print("mybatis forgotten      :", None)

stmt_count_jpa = sum(1 for s in (stmt0, stmt1) if s is not None)
stmt_count_forgot = 0
print("jpa sql count(1 change):", stmt_count_jpa)
print("mybatis sql count(miss):", stmt_count_forgot)
print("dirty check saves full :", stmt1.count(",") == 0)
print("forgotten loses write  :", stmt_count_forgot == 0)
